Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Evil], [Wizard], or [Demon Lord] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a purple Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer and return 1 card from your hand to your deck to gain 1 memory.
